In contrast the medical/assistant-phase cues and local phrase cues are separable in the L24 MLP input. Reference openings put 43% on Mi across cases where original assigns mean p=.0027 and chooses E in most generations; references also change discourse choice after sentence boundaries, rather than asking for a global register change. Built an L24-only causal patch with six independently measured clinical/position gates that correct these relative preferences, plus distinct high-confidence matched-pair acuity/prescription cues and brief continuation guards checked against alternate phrasings. The selected 84 channel slots had very small original writes (median residual RMS .02 across observed states). Embedding, final norm and all other blocks unchanged.')"}
